text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Troops besiege about 50 "terrorists" in Sidi Bouzid area, south of Algiers. The siege came after security forces wound up a huge offensive against gunmen holed up in the nearby Attatba area.
- Gunmen shot dead Doctor Ben Yahia in his clinic in the eastern town of Constantine. Ben Yahia, a member of the Rally for Culture and Democracy (RCD) party, was shot five times in the head.

- Security forces tighten grip on terrorist groups in Blida and Tipaza, south and west of Algiers. "More than 300 terrorists were killed in a huge opeeration (in Attatba in Blida region) since July 14."
- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia will outline his government programme before the National Assembly (lower house) soon.
- Algeria beat Benin 2-0 on Sunday to qualify for the soccer African Nations' Cup finals next February.
- Party leaders step up preparations for the local elections to be held on October 23.
